item.title: Pragmatic Anthropomorphism, or: How to Talk to an Autocompleting Cricket
item.description: TL;DR: Arguing over whether LLMs "truly understand" or have an inner spark misses what's actually useful when sitting in front of one. Treating an AI as a competent collaborator isn't magical thinking or naive anthropomorphism—it's pragmatic navigation of a vast latent space. Sometimes you have to suspend disbelief, show some objective respect, and let the alien eat its own spilled guts in peace.

item.title: The Internet Is Dead, Isn’t It?
item.description: Lately I keep feeling that the internet has become a worse place. Not necessarily louder or slower, but emptier in the places where people used to be visible. Ten or fifteen years ago I could move through small personal blogs, read along in forums, disagree in comments and learn something almost by accident. It was a web made of many small voices. They were not always clever or pleasant, but they were recognisably human.
